semiconductor_relevance: High — Mini-Lab provides specialized small-scale manufacturing equipment for semiconductor R&D, addressing key challenges in development and analysis processes.
summary: Mini-Lab Co., Ltd. develops, manufactures, and sells small-scale manufacturing equipment tailored for semiconductor research and development. The company supports both in-house and outsourced development processes by providing innovative solutions and specialized equipment to advance semiconductor technologies.
capabilities: Small-scale manufacturing equipment for semiconductor R&D
Solutions for in-house and outsourced semiconductor development

regional_presence.Japan: Mini-Lab has established a base for prototype development and demonstration experiments at Keio Fujisawa Innovation Village.
